key_finding: NOT primarily mitochondrial (Complex I-V) or apoptotic (BCL2/caspases). Multi-pathway convergent vulnerability: calcium/excitotoxicity (3/6), protein quality control (2/6), nitrosative stress (1/6)

double_hit_model.description: FOS (activity-dependent TF, SST_PLTS master regulator) directly regulates NOS1 (strongest neurodegeneration gene, padj=5.4e-72). Activity burden amplifies nitrosative stress vulnerability.
double_hit_model.implication: During high-activity states (e.g. tic suppression), FOS activation → NOS1 upregulation → excess NO → mitochondrial Complex I inhibition + protein S-nitrosylation. Combined with calcium overload (CALM2/CHRM3/GRIA3) and stressed proteostasis (UCHL1/PRNP), creates convergent vulnerability.
